chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Be righteous (to your parents) and shorten (your way) to Paradise, and if you are disobedient and hard-headed, then shorten (your way) to the Fire.'

key_terms.بَارّاً: Righteous, dutiful, specifically referring to kindness and obedience to parents

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of being disobedient to parents according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the binary spiritual outcome of parental treatment, linking filial piety (birr) directly to Paradise and ingratitude (uquq) to Hellfire. It underscores the Shia emphasis on the parents' status as a primary means of divine mercy, where one's conduct determines the brevity or length of their journey to the afterlife.
